- **Memory Complexity**: Requires storing distances and weights for all levels.

- **When not to use**: Bounded scenes with simple geometry where uniform sampling suffices; real-time applications where the overhead of multiple levels is prohibitive.
It builds on the original Mip-NeRF by adding a proposal network to guide sampling in unbounded scenes.
